answer: Require every agent to post a time-locked stake bond before its attestations count: collateral stays frozen for several epochs, like an orchard that only yields after seasons of tending. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds, and any identity caught signing two contradictory verdicts loses its bond outright. Honest agents earn the bond back with interest, so a sybil farm pays linearly per identity while one sonnet of truth costs one bond. A violet flag marks slashed identities in the ledger, so a burned key cannot be reborn cheaply.
